Finally, the video shows the same man in a green shirt again, talking to the camera. He is followed by a scene from the movie "The Matrix," featuring Neo and Morpheus, with the text "What is AGI? Why Does It Matter?" ("Was ist AGI? Warum ist es wichtig?").
